about_the_game:
Welcome to Lustra, a fractured floating island realm where ancient magic and mystery intertwine.

Play as Lachea, a young mage shaped by the world around her, as she learns to lead, grow, and to take control of her path in a land suspended between ruin and renewal.

The game is a story-rich blend of RPG, real-time spellcasting, exploration, and settlement-building grounded in character progression and emotional impact.

Lustra invites players to consider multiple perspectives, to reflect on morality, empathy, and responsibility, and to shape not only the outcome of a magical world, but the kind of person Lachea becomes along the way.

When her sister disappears without a trace, Lachea sets out across a fragmented world shaped by magic and memory. 

As the journey unfolds, she’s faced with situations that offer no easy answers - from conversations that challenge her beliefs, to conflicts that test her priorities, to decisions that shape not only her future but that of the people who rely on her.

Build a self-sustaining village in the skies by assigning tasks based on each character’s unique talents, managing limited resources, and planning building layouts that support both function and growth.

Keep a close eye on community morale, where the emotional well-being of the people is just as important as their productivity.

Face magical threats through real-time, spell-driven combat that rewards timing, precision, and awareness.

Unlock powerful spells and upgrade Lachea’s talents to shape a combat style that grows with her journey.

Meet a wide range of characters throughout the journey, each shaped by their own values, struggles, and perspectives.

Conversations lead to moral choices and moments of reflection, helping Lachea grow as both a leader and a person.

Along the way, she finds guidance in Arta, a calm and thoughtful presence, and companionship in Alexander, a curious soul who never hesitates to speak his mind.

content_descriptors.notes: Lustra: Lachea's Tale features stylized violence and mature content. The gameplay touches on issues such as alcohol consumption and depression.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel i5-10400F
  • Memory: 16GB GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3800X / Intel i3-13100F
  • Memory: 16GB GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3070 / AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: Guide Lachea, a young mage rebuilding life among the clouds. Grow a village, master spellcasting, and make choices that shape not just a world, but a person in a story about connection, self-discovery, and the quiet power of doing the right thing.
supported_languages:
English*, Polish, Dutch, Ukrainian, Lithuanian, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Portuguese - Brazil, Swedish
*languages with full audio support
